title: Billing
description: Review subscription state and start a hosted or virtual checkout flow.
paymentEnabledBody: Payment is enabled. The frontend will request a backend checkout session.
paymentDisabledBody: Payment is disabled. Use this page to validate family interest and plan content.
mockCheckoutEnabled: Demo checkout is enabled, so plan selection opens a virtual checkout for demos and tests.
mockCheckoutDisabled: Demo checkout is disabled. Real checkout requires a backend checkoutUrl response.
planLoading: Plan details are loading from the billing plans contract.
limitsBody: Locked states and upgrade prompts are advisory in the demo. Backend APIs must enforce message, upload, teacher-help, and report access limits.
securityBody: Hosted checkout is the preferred real payment direction. The browser never receives card details or payment secrets.
teacherUpgradeReason: Choose a plan with professional teacher support.
parentReportReason: A family plan is required for reports.
